verdict.rationale: Gladia documents code switching on its default model, solaria-1 (100+ languages), and has a guide for transcribing audio that switches languages. That implies the service identifies which language is being spoken at runtime. However, the guide says to 'use an explicit language list', so candidate languages still appear to be declared rather than fully auto-detected. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic language detection with no language declared, documentation of a detected-language field in the output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
